## Ireland Economic Policy Uncertainty Index

I maintain the Ireland Economic Policy Uncertainty Index dataset and related materials.

- External project page  
  <https://www.policyuncertainty.com/ireland_rice.html>

## Local downloads

If you would like to host a local copy of the dataset on this website, place your data files in the `files/` folder of your Quarto project and link to them from this page.

For example, if you add a file called `files/ireland-epu-index.xlsx`, you can link it like this.

- [Ireland EPU Index (CSV)](files/ireland-epu-index.xlsx)

You can also include documentation files in the same way, for example `files/ireland-epu-methodology.pdf`.

## Citation

If you want visitors to cite the dataset, add a short recommended citation here once you have settled the preferred format.
